isi_review: Restonya orang Bandar Lampung Lokasi 710 Berada di dekat Trans Mart Way Halim, akses ke sini cukup mudah. Sayang parkiran sempit, untungnya dibantu juru parkir. Suasana 710 Restonya cukup besar dengan dekorasi minimalis modern, tempatnya bersih, sirkulasi udara baik, pencahayaan cukup, privasi terjaga meski di tepi jalan raya. Open kitchennya terlihat higienis. Rasa 710 Resto ini menawarkan menu masakan Indonesia, pilihan menunya banyak. Pindang Baung kuahnya segar, taste pedas asamnya pas, tekstur ikan lembut. Pindang Iga kuahnya lebih kental dan agak over taste asamnya, iganya empuk dan mudah lepas tulang. Sop Ayam Kampung kuahnya bening, segar dengan taste gurih yang ringan, kaldu ayamnya cukup kuat, tekstur ayam sedikit overcooked. Nila Bakar bumbu bakarnya punya taste cenderung manis, panggangnya tidak terlalu gosong, bumbu meresap ke daging, tekstur ikan sudah pas tidak mentah atau overcooked. Tahu Unyil tahu goreng isi aci, isiannya hanya aci berbumbu, ditemani saus cocolan yang mirip sambal thailand. Es Dawet es dawet biasa tidak ada yang istimewa Es Yakult Strawberry paduan manis sirup dan asam yakultnya pas, ditambah potongan strawberry bikin makin segar Es Teh dan Jeruk memakai gula dan jeruk asli, tehnya biasa saja. Pelayanan 710 Penyajian makanan cukup lama tapi masih dimaklumi, waiter cukup cekatan dan tidak banyak omong. Fasilitas mushola, toilet dan wastafel sudah baik. Peralatan makan bersih dan bagus. isi_review: Once in a while, you have to hit a tourist trap, and here it is... We came for the view, which was ok and here end the good part of the review. The arrangement of chairs and tables and lights are seemingly made by a warehouse worker lagging guest comfort and a proper setup sitting on some tile benches... ...what to say. We ordered some food and cocktails, and the disappointment just continued. The pizza prepacked and heated up with ketchup instead of proper tomato sauce. The cocktails? Please dont ask... My 12 year old sister makes better cocktails if I supply her with proper spirits instead of trying to maximize profits with cheap ones like here. Only 3 of the 15 cocktails were available. This should have been a warning sign. Mojito with some peppermint spirit instead of rum and a daiquiri, which tastes like gummibears, But they charge the same price as a mediocre bar anywhere else in Indonesia. Yes, the staff was very nice, but that didnt weigh off the food and drink... The music Id perfect for fans of kampung dance off but not to relax and stay for longer. A one-time only thing which we happily would have avoided.

isi_review: Restoran ini terletak strategis di pusat kota, sangat dekat dengan Mall Boemi Kedaton. Lokasinya mudah diakses dan menawarkan lahan parkir yang cukup luas, baik di samping maupun di depan restoran. Bagi pengunjung yang menyukai suasana luar ruangan, restoran ini menyediakan area outdoor yang luas dengan atap untuk melindungi dari hujan. Namun, pada siang hari, area ini bisa menjadi cukup panas karena paparan sinar matahari langsung. Di dalam restoran, terdapat banyak ruang VIP yang menawarkan privasi lebih bagi pengunjung yang menginginkannya. Desain interior restoran ini modern dengan dominasi warna biru navy. Di bagian depan restoran, terdapat etalase es krim yang menarik perhatian, serta berbagai oleh-oleh khas Lampung yang bisa dibeli sebagai cendera mata. Menu yang ditawarkan di restoran ini sangat variatif dan mencakup lebih dari 70 halaman yang dapat diakses melalui scan barcode. Sistem pembayaran di restoran ini cukup fleksibel, di mana pengunjung dapat memesan terlebih dahulu dan membayar setelah selesai makan. Pelayanan di sini sangat ramah, memberikan pengalaman makan yang menyenangkan. Namun, setelah memasuki area utama tempat makan, aroma yang kurang sedap mulai tercium karena dekat dengan dapur dan aroma bumbu-bumbu yang terlalu menyengat. Hal ini sedikit mengurangi kenyamanan saat menyantap makanan. Akan lebih baik jika restoran bisa mengantisipasi asap dari dapur agar tidak menyebar ke area makan. Mayoritas pelanggan restoran ini berasal dari kalangan pekerja kantoran dan ASNBUMN, yang mencari tempat makan yang nyaman dan menyajikan berbagai pilihan menu.

alamat: KOMPLEK NAGA INTAN, Jl. Ikan Sepat, Pesawahan, Kec. Telukbetung Selatan, Kota Bandar Lampung, Lampung, Indonesia
isi_review: Lampungs food scene may surprise first-timers, and WaHaHa Seafood is one of the names that tends to surface oftenloved by locals, often buzzing with hungry groups. I keep coming back for the grouper and the Kung Pao chickentwo dishes that never miss. The grouper was served in a refreshing, sour-tinged sauce that complemented the delicate softness of the fish. It was clean, bright, and made me want to keep scooping back for more. The Kung Pao chicken, while lacking the usual cashew crunch youd expect in most Chinese kitchens, found its own identity with the addition of pineapplea sweet and tangy twist that worked surprisingly well. Still, a few toasted cashews would elevate it further. Prices are very reasonable for non-seafood dishes, staying within reach of the mid-market segment. Service is fairly quick, and even though I finished dining well past 2045 well after official closingthe staff handled the final hour gracefully. But the experience isnt without rough edges. When it rains, the entire parking entrance turns into a challenge. Theres no canopy, so grabbing a paper ticket means stepping out into the downpour. Worse still, the outdoor brick flooring quickly turns muddy and ankle-deep in waterfar from ideal for any diner in decent shoes. The restaurants asbestos roof makes rain sound like a drumline, which adds an unintentional intensity to every conversation. While there is an indoor, air-conditioned seating area, its located two flights upan obstacle for elderly guests or families with toddlers. On facilities, the restroom is standard, but the upstairs wash basin had water pressure so low that washing hands became a slow and awkward process. Thankfully, payment is frictionless with support for all methodscash, card, or digital. One charming touch? Two turtlesWawa and Hahanear the entrance that amuse visiting children and add a quirky welcome to the experience. Verdict WaHaHa Seafood delivers on flavor and familiarity, especially if you know what to order. But comfort and accessibility remain its biggest blind spots. Come for the grouper, stay for the pineapple twist, and bring patience if the clouds start rolling in.

isi_review: I was really disappointed when I had dinner here on Friday, 3rd January 2025. My family and I made a reservation for 7 pm at 2 pm, and we already ordered and made a payment. However, when we arrived, the food wasnt prepared. Even after waiting for 30 minutes, they served the wrong dishes. We showed them our receipt and waited for another 15 minutes, but the dishes were still wrong. We asked them to just take a picture of our receipt and bring it to the kitchen. Our dinner finally started around 815 pm. It was really disappointing. We had to follow up several times and even waited at the kitchen counter just to get our food. Additionally, we had to go to the kitchen counter ourselves to ask for iced tea and cutlery because no one brought it to us, despite us asking a couple of times and waiting for 30 minutes. I had high expectations for this restaurant because of its marketing, and they claimed to be the best seafood restaurant in Lampung. Unfortunately, the food was just okaynothing special about the seasonings.

alamat: KOMPLEK NAGA INTAN, Jl. Ikan Sepat, Pesawahan, Kec. Telukbetung Selatan, Kota Bandar Lampung, Lampung, Indonesia
isi_review: My family and I recently visited WaHaHa Seafood, expecting a pleasant dining experience. Unfortunately, it turned out to be quite the opposite. Upon arrival, no one greeted us or assisted us in finding a table. We had to find our own, which, while unusual for a restaurant of this kind, wasnt a major issue. However, the staffs lack of friendliness was disappointing. None of the waitstaff smiled or made us feel welcome, and while I understand it might have been a busy day, hospitality should never be compromised. We ordered a variety of dishes, but shortly after, we were informed that all the squid and the mixed crab set were unavailable. Its baffling that a seafood restaurant would run out of such staples. We had to adjust our order by adding more fish and shrimp dishes, which was frustrating. The waiting time for our food was around 30 minutes. While we understand that busy periods can cause delays, we were already very hungry by the time the food arrived. To add to our frustration, one of our orders udang tahu something was completely forgotten. It was clear that the restaurant was understaffed, with only one waitress handling most of the tables. This affected service quality significantly. The most unacceptable part of the experience was the prawns we received many of them still had their veins, which speaks to a serious lack of cleanliness and preparation standards. Ive attached photos to highlight this issue. For a seafood restaurant, this is completely unacceptable. Additionally, the water provided for washing hands was extremely hot. My mother attempted to take wudhu and nearly burned her hands. Such negligence toward customer safety is deeply concerning. Overall, this was a disappointing experience. The lack of cleanliness, understaffing, unavailability of key menu items, and poor service are all things that need urgent attention. I cannot recommend this restaurant to anyone unless significant improvements are made.

isi_review: Baru coba lg makan kesana sejak reopening, sempat tutup bbrp bulan lalu. Tp kaget dgn harganya yg sangat melonjak skrg, sate ayam 1 porsi 10 tusuk 70rb?? Dulu seingat saya sebelum tutup harganya masih 25rb an, pas buka lg dgn menu baru harga naik hampir 3x lipat. Dan ayam kampung 1 ekor 160rb is very pricey, di resto moro seneng 1 ekor ayam kampung cuma 100rb aja. Di resto lain rangenya 100-130, yg paling tinggi harganya cuma disini. Saya setiap hari keliling kuliner makan di luar jd sdh tau pasaran harga di lampung. Utk beberapa menu menurut saya terlalu mahal, porsinya juga tergolong standard kalau tdk bisa dibilang kecil. Apalagi restonya juga konsep outdoor dan bukan full ac, hrsnya harganya bisa lebih bersahabat. Bayar parkirnya juga per jam. Hrs di pertimbangkan lagi soal harga, karena banyak sekali resto sejenis di kota ini menawarkan rasa yg sama, porsi lebih besar, dgn harga yg lebih murah.

isi_review: Hallo kakak, sebagai pecinta Mie gacoan yang berawal dari Solo dan Jogja agak kaget karena pelayanan di Lampung ternyata berbeda. Yaps, aku rasa bisa jadi karena ada beberapa faktor yang menyebabkan demikian. Terhitung 3x saya bolak balik ditambah harus bawa struknya, seharusnya jika hal tersebut menjadi SOP maka disampaikan diawal ya kak hehe. Selanjutnya Es Gerobak Sodor dulu namanya Es pocong. Kami sangat excited dimanapun makan mie gacoan yang dicari pasti es tersebut. Tapi ternyata ini berbeda sekaliii, ntah dari tampilan yg tidak sesuai dengan visual atau rasanya juga. Semoga terus ada perbaikan yaa kak, baik dari pelayanan dan rasa yang disajikan Terutama kebersihan, agar kami pelanggan nyaman

Harga yang ditawarkan juga sangat terjangkau, menjadikannya pilihan yang baik untuk makan bersama keluarga atau teman. Secara keseluruhan, Kampung Kecil adalah tempat yang tepat untuk menikmati hidangan Indonesia yang lezat dalam suasana yang nyaman. Saya pasti akan kembali untuk mencicipi menu lainnya dan merekomendasikannya kepada teman-teman.
